nom: Bioderma Sensibio AR+ Cream Facial Redness Relief Lotion for Sensitive Skin

avis.titre: FAKE! Caused burning stinging and pain. AVOIDFAKE! Caused burning stinging and pain. AVOID
avis.texte: Counterfeit product-avoid! Don’t buy it from here, get the actual product from Bioderma directly. I used this and it made my face sting, itch and turn a bright red. Then came the BURNING! After avoiding it for a week my face is finally healing. I didn’t notice the horrible packaging until it was too late—compare the photo of the product I got to the actual product from Bioderma and you’ll see the difference. It is extremely unethical for a seller to send FAKE products that cause PAIN and redness all to make a dollar. Not cool.

My dermatologist recommended this cream for my redness and sensitive skin, and I’ve been using it daily. It’s lightweight, absorbs quickly, and provides good hydration without feeling greasy. It layers well under sunscreen and makeup and has helped calm my skin. The only downside is the scent—it has a slight petroleum-like smell that I don’t love. It’s not overpowering, though, and I got used to it after a while. A little goes a long way, so the tube lasts longer than I expected. Overall, I’d definitely buy it again.
Love the consistency of the cream. Does not feel greasy on my face, it moisturizes really well.

I have acne-prone sensitive skin and rosacea, and this moisturizer is amazingly lightweight and still hydrating and protective. I’m on like my 6th, I just wish it came in a bigger size! Sticking to this one for good, took a while to find. (Recommended by my dermatologist!)

avis.titre: Be wary of this product if you have sensitive skin.  It should never have been sold on Amazon.
avis.texte: Be wary of buying this product if you have sensitive skin. Both me and my wife have tried it on our faces and usage results in red & painful burning skin. It's supposed to reduce redness. It does the exact opposite. If I had the chance to return it I would. Unfortunately it was stored in a drawer until used. The sell-by date is however 07/27 - so it's not causing a problem because it has expired. Very disappointing.
Hydrate parfaitement, comparé à d'autres crèmes que j'ai essayées un peu cher par contre mais je laisse 5 étoiles vu la qualité Je recommande vivement!
So glad i tried this cream. The difference in redness in my face is amazing. Skin feels amazing all day. A little bit goes a long way.
Muy buena, me la recomendó mi dermatólogo para la dermatitis crónica severa. Calma, hidrata y es muy fácil de aplicar.

Why did you pick this product vs others?: By far the best OTC product for my rosacea prone skin! This line of Bioderma products for sensitive skin has greatly improved the moisture level, texture, and resistance to red/hot flareups on my face. I use it midday to help keep redness minimized and also at night after their defense serum and micellar water cleanse. Worth the extra couple of $$. Photos shows my nails rosacea flareup, same cheek about an hour later, and regular skin tone. PS - I do not wear makeup, so the micellar water alone is sufficient enough for cleansing.

I am very disappointed with this purchase. The Bioderma Sensibio AR+ Cream arrived with the box open at the bottom, which immediately raised concerns. The packaging looked tampered with, and the product inside did not seem authentic. Because of this, I strongly believe this item may be counterfeit. For a skincare product, especially one meant for sensitive skin, this is unacceptable and unsafe. I did not feel comfortable using it at all. I expected a sealed, original product from a reputable brand like Bioderma, but this was not the case.
La caja de la crema estaba abierta sin precinto de seguridad y el envase luce sucio. No se si está usado! Es difícil usar un producto para la piel en estas condiciones.

avis.titre: Suspicious packaging – does not look authentic
avis.texte: I do not trust the authenticity of this item and will be requesting a full refund. Very disappointing experience. • The tube and box design look different from what I know and from official images • The print quality and details seem off • Overall, it gives the impression of a counterfeit or tampered product Because this is a dermatological skincare product, I do not feel safe applying it to my face.

avis.titre: I don’t trust this one, poor quality control. Replacement requested
avis.texte: The box came open and the tube wasn’t sealed. The label around the tube was all wrinkled like it had been exposed to extreme temperatures. Not sure what that caused to the compounds in the product’s formula. I do not feel safe using this one I received but I know this cream is great. It was prescribed by my dermatologist, so I will give it another try. I already requested a replacement.
Producto que da muy mala imagen, estropeado como si hubiese pasado debajo de un camión. No me pondré el producto porque da impresión de que es falsificado. Horrible.

This product is fake. No protective seal, the cream has a stuck-on label (not in the original), packaging is blueish instead of white, and text is printed directly on the cream—no extra label. Not authentic. Don’t waist you money.
Box is broken, no seal and broken tip that are more than enough to return. Waste my time. Please do not send me trash.
There is no way this product is the original one. Didn’t feel comfortable using it. Refunded.
The package looks like it is a fake product, plus the moisturizer smells like plastics. Definitely very disappointing.
